description: The shared preset of zeabur-oss, plus Cargo crates, Nix and the release scripts' package.json, and the k3s test image of scripts/ci/kubernetes.sh, which follows K3s's stable channel (the k3s preset). Lock file maintenance updates flake.lock; the Rust nightly date in rust-toolchain.toml moves with the rust-toolchain manager, after the preset's seven-day wait.
